name: My Avatar
description: Design your own character: hair, eyes, outfits, hats and places. Stars earned in the other apps buy new items, and your portrait shows on the home screen.

about.concept: Identity, choice and delayed reward. The child designs a character that stands for her, and the stars earned across the other apps are the currency for new items, so effort elsewhere has a visible result here.
about.progression: Everything basic is free. Hair, outfits, hats, glasses, backgrounds and frames cost stars, with prices rising for the more elaborate items, so saving for something becomes a choice the child makes.
